run_train: run the train function to train an MViT model on a dataset using the provided config
run_test: run the test function to evaluate a pretrained MViT model on a test set
run_train_epoch: run the train_epoch function to perform one epoch of training with mixed precision and mixup support
run_eval_epoch: run the eval_epoch function to evaluate the model on a validation set and compute top1 and top5 errors
review_train: review the train function which orchestrates distributed training with checkpointing, evaluation, and epoch timing
